description: Golden parity for the field-classification kernel: fieldsVisibleTo(roles, entity) + selectFor(roles, entity) for assessmentResult. Asserted IDENTICALLY by the REAL TS fieldsVisibleTo/selectFor (tests/access/field-classification-fixtures.test.ts) and the C# FieldClassification kernel (Tims.UnitTests FieldClassificationFixtureTests). Field order = registry-declaration order; selectFor = anchors then visible fields. A behavior change (e.g. dropping 'external' from a field's roles) edits this JSON once and turns BOTH CIs red.

cases.name: fieldsVisibleTo external → the full six-field psychometric ceiling
fieldsVisibleTo super_admin → all six (raw + scores + modelVersion)
fieldsVisibleTo hr_admin → scores + modelVersion (no raw)
fieldsVisibleTo hrbp → scores only (no raw, no modelVersion)
fieldsVisibleTo recruiter → scores only
fieldsVisibleTo employee → scores only
fieldsVisibleTo empty roles → none (fail-closed)
fieldsVisibleTo unknown entity → none (fail-closed)
selectFor external → anchors + the full six-field ceiling
selectFor empty roles → anchors only
selectFor unknown entity → { id } only (safe minimum)
fieldsVisibleTo hr_admin employeeCompensation → all six comp fields
fieldsVisibleTo employee employeeCompensation → salary/currency/effectiveDate only (no finance fields)
fieldsVisibleTo recruiter employeeCompensation → none (not a comp reader)
selectFor hr_admin employeeCompensation → anchors + all six comp fields
selectFor employee employeeCompensation → anchors + salary/currency/effectiveDate
fieldsVisibleTo super_admin salaryAdjustment → all six (previous/new/currency/reason + type + status)
fieldsVisibleTo hr_admin salaryAdjustment → all six
fieldsVisibleTo hrbp salaryAdjustment → type + status only (no restricted salary fields)
fieldsVisibleTo leader salaryAdjustment → status ONLY (bite: NO previousSalary/newSalary/reason)
fieldsVisibleTo employee salaryAdjustment → status ONLY (bite: NO previousSalary/newSalary/reason)
fieldsVisibleTo recruiter salaryAdjustment → none (not an adjustment reader)
selectFor hr_admin salaryAdjustment → anchors + all six
selectFor leader salaryAdjustment → anchors + status ONLY (bite: never the restricted salary fields)
selectFor employee salaryAdjustment → anchors + status ONLY (bite)
